positions.description:

projects.title: Facial Recognition Security System
projects.description: We designed a mobile system that uses a Raspberry Pi with a camera to identify faces, utilizing the OpenCV library in Python. If you are an allowed user that has been registered, the system will display your name and allow access into our container, which may hold any sort of items that the user wants to keep protected. It uses a relatively simple menu that allows users to quickly and easily access the unlocking mechanism. Those with the master passcode are able to give access to other users by entering their name, taking a number of pictures of them, then integrating them into the system. Each attempt to unlock the box via facial scanning is logged with their system-identity (either their name given upon registry or Invalid User). If the user is registered in the system, the container will unlock for them, and if they are not, the container remains locked.

projects.title: Chat Web Application
projects.description:
Led a team in the creation of a fully-featured Chat Application utilizing Flask (Python web framework), HTML, CSS, and SQLAlchemy (SQL Toolkit) for database needs.
Interpreted and stuck to project requirements while using the Agile development methodology.
Worked with team to manage project scope in order to meet deadlines.
Created user registration, login, and user settings to customize username, upload a profile picture, and set a status.
Designed a relational database for friending and blocking features.
Implemented direct user-to-user chat with friends, as well as Group Chats.
Utilized CSS to create an intuitive UI.
